text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: HIGH - inference.prod.us-east.p99 > 1200ms for 5m. Alert ID: PD-98321. Auto-page to oncall.
alice-oncall: acked in PD (PD-98321) - I'm online. starting triage.
bob-sre: seeing p99 tail spike across inference frontends and kvcache miss rate up ~4x. sending traces.
alice-oncall: thanks. any obvious rollout/commit that could cause this?
ops-bot: deploy-bot: recent rollout #r-2025-03-11 to inference-sidecars at 01:12 UTC (10% canary) — no automated rollback.
kyle-runtime: digging into hotpath. early hypothesis: tokenizer coldstart + dense KV evictions after a bad cache pressure event. evictions spike at 01:06 UTC.
bob-sre: logs (excerpt):
```
[01:07:33] kvcache: evict key batch=hotkeys count=412 latency/ms=3
[01:07:34] runtime: decode-loop p99=1370ms requests=1200
[01:07:35] runtime: model-variant-fallback=none
```
alice-oncall: can we short-circuit by routing non-critical traffic to a cheaper/fast variant? e.g., gen-small for short prompts?
kyle-runtime: yes. can flip routing policy to degrade quality for long tail requests — we have a compatible quantized variant rdx-gen-4q8a which has 40% lower p99.
bob-sre: propose immediate mitigations:
- enable regional fallback to dedicated pool in us-east-2
- throttle/reclassify low-priority routes (batch analytics, background evals)
- enable rdx-gen-4q8a for routes with seq_len>1024
- warm kvcache (prefetch top hotkeys)
alice-oncall: doing the throttle + variant flip now. running command:
```
rictl route update --service=inference --route=background-eval --rate-limit=10rps
rictl model-route set --service=inference --route=chat-long --model=rdx-gen-4q8a --precedence=low-latency
```
(kyle-runtime): warming cache script started: `scripts/warm_kvcache --keys-file /opt/hotkeys/top_500.txt` — ETA ~90s.
dave-cs: heads-up: customer-impact check — which customers affected? I can prepare comms for anyone in the top-10.
bob-sre: telemetry shows the spike primarily hitting self-serve and mid-market prod tenants on us-east. small fraction of enterprise traffic routed to dedicated still fine. customer list: acct_331, acct_77, acct_eco.
alice-oncall: @dave-cs please prepare an advisory for affected mid-market tenants. mention degraded latency on long context chat routes, mitigation in progress, ETA 30m.
dave-cs: on it. will share draft in #customer-success.
ops-bot: autoscaler: requested scale to dedicated pool `dedicated-us-east-2` +4 replicas; approval required.
carla-opslead: approving scale. do it and start reroute.
kyle-runtime: scaling + reroute executed:
`rictl pool scale --pool=dedicated-us-east-2 --delta=4`
`rictl traffic shift --from=prod-us-east-1 --to=dedicated-us-east-2 --pct=25`
alice-oncall: monitoring. p95 improving slightly, p99 still elevated but trending down (01:11 -> 01:16 UTC).
bob-sre: re: long tail, we saw one noisy key causing kv churn; cache prewarm completed 01:13 and eviction rate halved.
alice-oncall: quick customer impact summary for PD notes: 01:06 alerts start; 01:09 mitigation (throttle + variant flip) applied; 01:11 kvcache warm complete; 01:13 scale + traffic shift in progress; 01:16 p99 trending down from 1400ms -> 680ms; continuing to monitor.
carla-opslead: please prepare for handoff in 20m. if we still have >10% breach we keep oncall extended.
alice-oncall: will continue to monitor for 30m. if stable at 01:46 UTC I'll close PD.
kyle-runtime: quick followups to run after stabilizing:
- add adaptive eviction backpressure threshold for kvcache
- add a tiny model-variant as immediate emergency fallback in routing
- add unit to keep small warm set in memory across restarts
bob-sre: created issue INF-2047 for postmortem & RCA. tagging runtime and oncall rotation.
ops-bot: incident-bot: PD-98321 escalated to SRE lead (carla-opslead) at 01:18 UTC due to sustained p99 > 800ms for 8m.
carla-opslead: acknowledged handoff. I'll take over monitoring window. alice, thanks for triage and actions.
alice-oncall: handing off logs + runbook link: https://internal.redwood/incident/INF-2047/runbook — notes included.
dave-cs: customer advisory posted to status page draft: "We're investigating increased response times in US-East for long-context chat. Mitigations in progress." will notify top-3 after final confirmation.
carla-opslead: 01:24 UTC p99 now ~480ms, p95 stable. marking incident as mitigated; keeping PD open for verification window (30m).
incident-bot: PagerDuty: RESOLVED - PD-98321 (inference p99 latency) at 01:36 UTC. auto-close in 30m if no regressions.
carla-opslead: closing notes: root cause likely cache eviction cascade triggered by recent canary and a hotkey pattern. mitigation: throttles + variant fallback + dedicated scale + prewarm. follow-ups in INF-2047.
alice-oncall: thanks team :thumbsup:
kyle-runtime: will schedule a quick config change to keep warmset persistent. ETA PR tomorrow.
bob-sre: leaving a short blameless note in the issue. good job everyone.
